_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Inwe Player {player_id} katika mchezo wa LinesOfAction.
Goli yako ni '{side}', goli la piny owacho ni '{other}'.
Mfumo wa kusonga: `[b1b3]` (kutoka-eneo hadi-eneo). Sunga mweri huruka kando, juu-mbali, au diagonally nambari ya miraba sawa na jumla ya goli (rangi yoyote) katika mstari ule. Inaweza kuruka juu ya goli yako mwenyewe, lakini si goli la piny owacho; kudhi kwa piny owacho kunaikamata.  Winwe wakati goli zako zote zimeunganishwa na jirani 8.

board.current_board: Board: {board} mar ariyo e wi weche mag siasa.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yo ma ondikgo weche nyaka bed e2e4 (a,to coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Kama ne giae koda kama ne gidhiyoe chalre.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Nyaka ng'ato wuothi tir kata kochomo komachielo.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Nyaka ochwalgi e bor maromre gi kuonde ma gichokoree.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Kit kodi kwa adui kawo koro.
invalid_move.destination_own: Destination ma ne idhi chopoe en achiel kuom kuondego.
